text:
leo: planning a low-noise rollout for `llmroute_v3_gradual`. change window 01:00-04:00 UTC. objective: minimize churn and allow long-soak cohorts. plan: 0.1% micro-canary eu-west -> 1% after 20m -> 5% after 60m -> 20% after 2h -> optional slow soak to 60% over remaining window. hold at each step until telemetry and eval green. pin model-route v3.0.9 for the entire window. quiet-window: no other route/model changes 00:30-05:00. @deploybot please schedule, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: ack scheduled. steps queued: 01:00 0.1% canary, 01:20 check, 01:30 1%, 02:30 check, 03:00 5%, 03:30 check, 04:00 20% (optional continuation to 60% per green metrics). will post snapshots and confirmations.

ana: suggested rollback triggers: sustained p95 > 420ms for 5m OR error-rate > 0.4% over 5m OR token-queue-length > 2.0x baseline. add slow-soak guard: if any gate trips during 20%->60% soak, cap at previous safe cohort and open incident.

rahul: +1. also include a semantic quality gate: nightly prompt-eval drift > 1.5% vs baseline => rollback. we'll run a 30-prompt quick-eval after the 1% and 5% steps.

product-maya: customer comms: very small blurb on status page for eu-west only, include fallback guarantee and SRE contact. RN id RN-2026-512. keep wording minimal.

sre-oncall: standing by. i'll mute non-actionable alerts and watch p95, error-rate, cpu, token-queue-length, db-conns, and eval pass rate. will execute manual pin if needed.

leo: rollback action plan: auto-rollback will pin routing to v2.9.4 and disable `llmroute_v3_gradual` cohorts. manual rollback runbook step includes cache flush and revoke canary warmers. runbook: https://go/runbooks/llmroute-gradual (see "fast-pin & cache-cleanup").

deploybot: rollback command configured for ops:
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_gradual --pin-version v2.9.4 --reason "telemetry or eval"
```

ana: add circuit behavior: if token-queue-length spikes > 3x baseline for 3m, temporarily drain new cohorts to 0% for 5m, then attempt a single 1% re-check only if metrics normalize. log incident id on any auto-action.

rahul: on rollback ensure we also revert any client-side sticky cookies issued during canary. adding note in runbook.

sre-oncall: canary 0.1% executed at 01:00 UTC. metrics snapshot expected ~01:10. I'll post early signals.

deploybot: metrics snapshot (01:10): p95=310ms, error-rate=0.09%, cpu=46%, token-queue-length=1.02x baseline. prelim green. holding until 01:20 check.

leo: if 1% is green at 01:30, schedule quick-eval and move to 5% at 03:00 per plan. enforce quiet-window and block routing flips.

product-maya: I'll publish the small status update after 1% hold passes. keep it short: "eu-west routing experiment; automatic fallback available."

sre-oncall: watching. will call rollback on any hard gate or escalate ambiguous cases.
